data.description: Brand New | Lagoon View | Modern Living
data.display_address: Azizi Mirage 1, Dubai Studio City, Dubai
data.long_description:
Experience modern living at its finest in this brand-new home boasting breathtaking lagoon views. Thoughtfully designed with elegance, comfort, and functionality in mind, this residence offers a bright and airy ambiance that instantly feels welcoming. Expansive interiors and refined finishes create the perfect setting for both relaxed everyday living and stylish entertaining. Ideally located in a prime area, you’ll enjoy convenient access to shopping destinations, fine dining, cafés, and a variety of leisure and entertainment options—all just moments away.

Features:

Contemporary architectural design with premium, high-quality finishes
Floor-to-ceiling windows that flood the space with natural light and showcase stunning lagoon views
Spacious open-plan layout, seamlessly connecting living, dining, and kitchen areas
Modern kitchen with sleek cabinetry and ample storage
Built-in wardrobes and smart storage solutions for added convenience
High-speed internet connectivity and smart home readiness

Amenities:

Beautiful lagoon-view swimming pool
Fully equipped, state-of-the-art fitness center
Lush landscaped gardens and scenic walking paths
24/7 security and professional concierge services
Safe and engaging children’s play area
Dedicated resident parking
This exceptional home offers a perfect blend of style, comfort, and convenience—an ideal choice for those seeking a vibrant yet serene waterfront lifestyle.
